comments.body:
Did you follow all the steps in the guide of the itshop?

Here’s the link to the one for Windows machines:
https://itshop.ethz.ch/EndUser/KB/Article/136d7d9d-613e-067e-678d-49b71d0d9b01

The important parts are connecting to \\software.ethz.ch\username$ and then using d\username (if not logged into eth domain) as your username when prompted for authentication.
comments.author: Arykku
